_metadata.method: Contextual inference from partially decoded JP text + English guide cross-reference (guide_full.txt)
_metadata.notes: Resource 1053 is type03 (graphical data), not a text resource. All inferences come from resource 2654 which contains Alleid Action (cooperative combat technique) descriptions. Glyph data starts at byte offset 842 in the type44 format.

942.reason: 前衛/後衛 (front/back row) - core alleid combat term. Always paired with 前(583) or 後(732). 46x occurrences across all 34 messages.

583.reason: 前衛 (front row/vanguard) in alleid descriptions. English guide: 'front row companions'. 26x. Duplicate of glyph 510/597.

732.reason: 後衛 (back row) and 最後 (end of turn). English guide: 'back row companions'. 27x.

279.reason: 攻め手する (to attack) - 44x. Core combat verb in every alleid description. English: 'attack'.

293.reason: 魔王(magic lord/power), 魔法(magic spell). 31x. Context: magic barriers, spell activation, enchantments.

292.reason: 魔法 (magic/spell) - paired with 魔(293). 17x. Context: 魔法バリア, 魔法を行使, etc.

441.reason: 大きな/大きく (big/greatly). 9x. 大きなダメージ(big damage), 大きくアップ(greatly increase). Duplicate of 295.

556.reason: ダメージを与える (deal damage). 8x. Standard RPG combat phrasing. Duplicate of 371.

592.reason: 同時に (simultaneously), 同じ (same). 4x. Matches alleid coordination/timing context.

450.reason: 武器 (weapon) paired with 器(697). Context: 武器を振るって(swing weapon), 武器に信じて(trust in weapon). 5x.

697.reason: 武器 (weapon) paired with 武(450). MSG22 matches ENCHANT: 'enchants the weapon of front row fighter'. 5x.

577.reason: 攻め手を受ける (receive attack). 5x. Standard combat verb. Duplicate of 902.

536.reason: 代わりに(instead), 身代わり(substitute/decoy). Matches BACK COVER/RESTRICT SHOT descriptions. 3x.

278.reason: 防衛すべき (should be defended). RESTRICT SHOT: protecting front row from physical attacks. 3x.

694.reason: 強力な(powerful), 強制的に(forcefully). Used for powerful magic barriers and forced spell interruptions. 5x.

606.reason: 行使 (exercise/use power). 魔法を行使しようとした(tried to use magic). Matches MAGIC CANCEL alleid. 3x. Duplicate of 281/647.

584.reason: パーティ全員 (all party members). 14x. Context: whole party acting together in alleid descriptions.

657.reason: 振るって (to swing/brandish). 武器を振るって(swing weapons). 2x.

840.reason: 唱える (to cast/chant). 魔法を唱える(cast a spell). Matches MAGIC COOPERATION alleid. 2x.

622.reason: 通常攻撃 (normal attack). BACK COVER: party vulnerable to normal attacks. 2x. Duplicate of 972.

795.reason: 通常 (normal/regular). Paired with 通(622) in 通常攻撃. 2x.

440.reason: 後退し (retreat). FAKE ATTACK: decoy retreats when attacked. 1x. Duplicate of 931.

580.reason: 消えてしまう (will disappear). EVASIVE MANEUVER: mirror images disappear when hit. 1x. Duplicate of 545.

588.reason: 強制的に (forcefully) - 的 as adverbial suffix. Matches MAGIC/BREATH CANCEL: forcefully interrupts. 3x.

290.reason: 発動させて (activate spell/magic). 15x. If glyph 285=発(not罰 as mapped), then 発動 is perfect. Also possibly 命中(hit rate) in other contexts.

630.reason: 回避力 (evasion power). Context: high-evasion monsters in HOLD ATTACK description. Paired with 回(467). 5x.

467.reason: 回避力(evasion), 回数(count), 回りこんで(sneak around). 21x. Multi-use kanji in alleid descriptions.

541.reason: 制限される (be limited/restricted). Attack counts limited in alleid descriptions. 6x. Duplicate of 548.

837.reason: 制限される (be limited/restricted). Paired with 限(541). 9x. Duplicate of 638.

595.reason: 効果する(take effect), 効果回数(activation count). Alleid effect system. 7x. Duplicate of 431.

790.reason: 有効 (effective). Describes effectiveness of attack strategies. 2x.

429.reason: 上げ(raise), 立ち上がり(standing up). Launching enemies into air for attack combos. 4x. Duplicate of 328.

604.reason: 味方 (ally/companion). Paired with 方(601). Refers to party members in alleid descriptions. 5x.

601.reason: 味方 (ally/companion). Paired with 味(604). Context: 味方の武器(ally weapon), 味方とともに(with allies). 6x. Duplicate of 546.

479.reason: 攻手に対する (regarding attacks), 対応する (respond to). Defensive/support alleid descriptions. 3x. Duplicate of 374.

1303.reason: 囮 (decoy/bait). MSG18/25 match BACK ATTACK English: 'one person will act as a decoy'. 2x.

600.reason: 進化 (evolution). Alleid actions evolving through special class participation. 3x.

466.reason: 進化(evolution), 変化(transformation). Paired with 進(600). 6x.

405.reason: 編集する (edit/compile/reorganize). Reorganizing magic in alleid descriptions. 2x.

565.reason: 威力(power/might) or 効力(effectiveness). Used in alleid power descriptions. 6x. Duplicate of 346/503.

666.reason: 取り (to take/obtain). MSG7: status immunities を取り. 2x. Note: conflicts with prior r47 inference 666=異.

1294.reason: 存在 (existence/presence). Special class presence triggers alleid evolution. 3x.

701.reason: 存在 (existence/presence). Paired with 存(1294). Duplicate of 706. 3x.

1257.reason: 攻撃対象/標的 (attack target). MSG4: 'attack target'. 4x. Note: 588 also inferred as 的 in different context.

570.reason: 敵 (enemy) in MSG30: 'those in position are not attack targets'. 2x.
